real_estate
Master‑planned gated residential compound (420 villas) in Al Narjis, North Riyadh
idea
feasibility
الأدلة (8)

Debt financing terms: interest rate 6.5% per annum, 15‑year tenor, covenants include a debt‑service coverage ratio of 1.25 and a maximum leverage of 70% of project value.

ai_assumption · 65%

Mortgage facilitation structure: 30% of the 420 villas (126 units) will be offered through mortgage facilitation, with an expected uptake rate of 70% (≈88 units). The average loan amount per villa is estimated at SAR 2.5 million.

ai_assumption · 60%

Pre‑sale commitments: 150 units have been pre‑sold at 90% of the average selling price (SAR 3.78 million per villa). The payment schedule is 20% deposit at signing, 30% at 6 months, and 50% at completion.

ai_assumption · 70%

Construction schedule: 5‑year total project life – 1 year for site preparation and approvals, 3 years for construction, and 1 year for finishing, hand‑over, and marketing.

ai_assumption · 65%

Regulatory approval timeline: municipal approval 6 months, Wafi compliance 3 months, and other permits (environmental, utilities) 2 months, totaling 11 months before off‑plan sales can commence.

ai_assumption · 60%

Projected cash‑flow: Total project cost SAR 1.8 billion (hard SAR 882 M + soft SAR 95 M + 8% contingency). Equity 35% (SAR 630 M), debt 65% (SAR 1.17 B). Expected sales revenue SAR 1.764 B (420 × SAR 4.2 M). Net cash flow turns positive by year 4, break‑even reached at the end of year 3.5.

ai_assumption · 70%

Contingency allocation: 8% of hard costs (SAR 70.56 M) is earmarked for construction overruns, 4% of total cost (SAR 36 M) for financing cost escalations, and 4% (SAR 36 M) for regulatory delays and unforeseen approvals.

ai_assumption · 65%

Market absorption validation: Based on comparable master‑planned developments in Riyadh and a 3% annual population growth in the Al Narjis area, an absorption rate of 70 units per year is realistic and aligns with current demand forecasts.

ai_assumption · 70%

idea
investment
الأدلة (8)

Projected annual revenue: Year 1 ≈ SAR 66 M, Year 3 ≈ SAR 145 M, Year 5 ≈ SAR 211 M, based on 550 SAR/kW/month pricing and the stated occupancy ramp.

ai_assumption · 80%

Annual OPEX (excluding power) broken down as: staff 15 M SAR, maintenance 10 M SAR, security 5 M SAR, insurance 3 M SAR, taxes 5 M SAR, other 10 M SAR, totaling 48 M SAR.

ai_assumption · 70%

Depreciation: straight‑line over 20 years, 45 M SAR per year. Corporate tax rate in Saudi Arabia is 20 %.

ai_assumption · 80%

Debt amount: 60 % of 900 M SAR = 540 M SAR. Annual debt service (principal + interest) ≈ 69.8 M SAR over a 12‑year tenor at 7.5 % nominal interest.

ai_assumption · 80%

Construction phases: Phase 1 (first 12 months) – 10 MW, 1 000 racks; Phase 2 (next 12 months) – 15 MW, 1 500 racks; Phase 3 (final 12 months) – 15 MW, 1 500 racks.

ai_assumption · 70%

Power consumption: total facility power ≈ 52 MW (40 MW IT × 1.30 PUE). Power per rack ≈ 13 kW; per MW of IT load ≈ 1.3 MW of facility power.

ai_assumption · 80%

Projected cash‑flow (simplified): Year 1 EBITDA ≈ –45 M SAR, Year 3 EBITDA ≈ 34 M SAR, Year 5 EBITDA ≈ 100 M SAR. Debt‑service coverage ratios: Year 1 –0.64, Year 3 0.49, Year 5 1.44.

ai_assumption · 70%

Regulatory approvals required: SDA licensing, Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs, Ministry of Energy for grid interconnection, Environmental Impact Assessment under the Ministry of Environment, Energy and Industry. Estimated ESG compliance and licensing costs ≈ 2 M SAR.

ai_assumption · 70%
